mainEntity.name: What is AI Search Optimization (AEO) and how does it differ from traditional SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI Search Optimization (AEO) utilizes artificial intelligence to enhance content visibility and performance across various search engines and AI-powered platforms. Unlike traditional SEO, which primarily focuses on keyword ranking for web search results, AEO broadens its scope to include conversational AI, voice search, and personalized content delivery. It analyzes complex user intent, predicts search trends, and optimizes for rich results and featured snippets, aiming for holistic visibility in an increasingly AI-driven search landscape.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI Search Optimization (AEO) uses AI to improve content visibility across search engines and AI platforms, differing from traditional SEO by focusing on broader visibility, conversational AI, and personalized content.
